description: Artwork whose thinnest stroke was not measured (the estimate ran out of its work budget, so minStrokeMm is absent while the relief is there): warning on artwork that is not fit-critical.

findings.fix: simplify the artwork (fewer, smoother outlines; Inkscape: Path > Simplify) if you want its strokes checked; the opening still removed every stroke thinner than the relief.svg feature's minFeature (the process minimum unless the feature sets one), so you may export as it is
findings.message: the thinnest stroke of the artwork was not measured: the artwork is too detailed for the stroke estimate's work limit, so nothing shows that its strokes reach the 0.8 mm minimum feature of process `fdm-0.4`
